dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Greetings, friend. I hope you've been holding up well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: I am the chief of the Scions of the Canopy. You may call me Wayna.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Some people like to call me "Uncle Wayna," but please don't follow their example. Seriously, I'm not that old.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: To me, "maturity" is more like a fashion style.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: All it means is that I have the most adventuring experience out of everyone in the tribe. It's got nothing to do with my real age. Understand?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I trust you've been well?

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Of course, of course. Everything here has been going fine.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: What about you? Thinking about taking some risks again?

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: I'd consider everything you've done to be quite risky, you know. Going to the Night Kingdom, and breaking Citlali's Spiritspeaker Stone... In my opinion, both of those are extremely important yet risky endeavors.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: It's good to have the spirit of adventure, but it can also be a double-edged sword. I know you won't like to hear this, but it doesn't hurt to be a bit more careful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You too, see you later.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Farewell for now, my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About fighting the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Ah, well... I suppose it's not going too badly.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: If war with the Abyss was seen as just another type of extreme sport, then there'd be nothing about it that we Scions of the Canopy couldn't handle.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Just like jumping off a cliff — some would jump straight back, others land safely, while others might fly off to even farther places.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Every outcome has a value of its own, and thus, deserves to be remembered.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Haha! Our old enemy's gone all quiet now.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Our long battle with the Abyss has been like an extreme sport marathon, but there's nothing that the Scions of the Canopy can't overcome.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Like with cliff-jumping, some come straight back up, others land safely, and still others fly off to yet farther places.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Every outcome has a value of its own, and thus, deserves to be remembered.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me. I'm pretty amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: Haha, confidence. I like it!

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: I've heard about you — the outlander who can use phlogiston. That's more than just pretty amazing, if I do say so myself.

dialogues.speaker: Wayna
dialogues.text: In that case, these should be useful to you, right? Take 'em — and no need to be polite about it.
